overview: Removes particles and residues before metallization, bonding, microscopy, or optical thermometry. Cleaning chemistry, time, and power must be selected for the material because cavitation can damage fragile structures.
overviewZh: 在金属沉积、键合、显微观察或光学热测量前去除颗粒与残留物。清洗液、时间和功率需按材料选择，因为空化可能损伤脆弱结构。
principle: A transducer drives pressure oscillations in the cleaning liquid. Cavitation bubbles grow and collapse, producing local shear, shock waves and near-surface microjets that dislodge contaminants. Cleaning also depends on solvent chemistry; excessive cavitation can damage fragile films or structures.
principleZh: 换能器在清洗液中产生超声压力振荡，空化气泡生长并塌缩，形成局部剪切、冲击波与近表面微射流，剥离污染物。清洗效果还取决于清洗液化学性质，过强空化可能损伤脆弱薄膜或结构。
